services.name: Portable 9-hole course, 3-hour party for 12
services.story: The main story: a portable 9-hole course for a 3-hour party for 12, $300. A $60 deposit now, the $240 rest charged to the saved card when the crew texts DONE.

services.story: A school carnival course for up to 20 kids, 2 hours: $180, a card saved for the $40 late-cancel fee; the crew sends the bill after.

services_shape: table: a course round is a space for an hour (up to 4 players); a party is a set time with a set number of players; go-karts and laser tag are added to a booking
questions_before_times: which round, party or portable course, and the date and time
how many players, and each one's age group (under 7, 7 to 17, or adult)
for a party: the expected number of guests
for a portable course: the kind of place (a yard, a school, a park) and the town
safety_stop: someone hit by a kart, or a crash with someone hurt or bleeding, or someone choking or not breathing right now
a child missing from the course or the party
first_steps: a waiver for every player, signed on the secure page before the visit and good for 12 months; a parent signs for each child
the party's final headcount 3 days before (it sets the rest due)
a portable course: the customer confirms the flat area, any outlet the crew needs, and any permission the place needs, 3 days before
license: where the state's rules require it: the business's registration, and a permit for the go-karts or the course where the state requires one; a portable course follows the same rules where they cover it
staff_skills: course host, kart marshal, party host, portable course crew
messages_never: children's names, ages and health answers, and injury details: only on the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
